title: Peace vs. Panic: 3 Biblical Tests
hook: Is it God or just anxiety? Use these 3 tests in 60 seconds.
script: Is it God or just anxiety? Use these 3 tests in 60 seconds. You pray, but your mind starts sprinting. First, the Scripture Test: does this thought align with God's character? God doesn't give a spirit of fear but power, love, and a sound mind (2 Timothy 1:7). His wisdom is pure, peaceable, and gentle (James 3:17). Second, the Fruit Test: is it growing love, joy, and peace in you? (Galatians 5:22-23). Third, the Shepherd Test: does it sound like the Good Shepherd you know? (John 10:27). Breathe 4-7-8, ask those three questions, write a one-sentence prayer. He keeps in perfect peace those who trust Him (Isaiah 26:3). Journal outcomes for a week.

title: Hear the Shepherd, Not the Storm
hook: If your chest is tight after praying, listen to this.
script: If your chest is tight after praying, listen to this. God's voice leads; anxiety shoves. The Good Shepherd calls His sheep by name and they recognize His voice (John 10:27). So try three filters. Scripture: does this match God's heart - power, love, and a sound mind, not panic? (2 Timothy 1:7). Wisdom from above is pure, peaceable, gentle, willing to yield (James 3:17). Fruit: is love, joy, and peace increasing? (Galatians 5:22-23). Now slow your body with 4-7-8 breathing, ask those questions, then pray one sentence: 'Jesus, lead me by Your peace, not pressure.' You'll be kept in perfect peace as you trust Him (Isaiah 26:3). Try it daily for seven days and note the difference.

title: Stop Overthinking God's Will
hook: You may be overthinking this - here's how to tell panic from God's peace.
script: You may be overthinking this - here's how to tell panic from God's peace. Pause for one breath: inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8. Now ask three things. Does this align with Scripture and God's character? He gives power, love, and a sound mind, not torment (2 Timothy 1:7), and His wisdom is peaceable and gentle (James 3:17). What fruit shows up when I follow it - love, joy, peace? (Galatians 5:22-23). Does it sound like the Shepherd I know? (John 10:27). Finish with a one-sentence prayer: 'Lord, I choose Your way of peace.' He keeps in perfect peace the mind stayed on Him (Isaiah 26:3). Test this for a week and journal what changes.
